description: This file defines the ServiceEngine class, which models the <service-engine> element in a configuration XML for the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes parsing logic for various sub-elements such as authorization, engine, service locations, notification groups, and others, and provides accessor methods for these components.

classes.name: ServiceEngine
classes.description: Models the <service-engine> configuration element, encapsulating its properties and sub-elements such as engines, service locations, notification groups, and thread pool.

methods.name: ServiceEngine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ServiceEngine object by parsing the provided XML element.

methods.name: getAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the Authorization object associated with this service engine.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Retrieves an Engine object by its name from the engine map.

methods.name: getEngines
methods.description: Returns the list of Engine objects.

methods.name: getGlobalServices
methods.description: Returns the list of GlobalServices objects.

methods.name: getJmsServiceByName
methods.description: Finds and returns a JmsService by its name.

methods.name: getJmsServices
methods.description: Returns the list of JmsService objects.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service engine.

methods.name: getNotificationGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of NotificationGroup objects.

methods.name: getResourceLoaders
methods.description: Returns the list of ResourceLoader objects.

methods.name: getServiceEcas
methods.description: Returns the list of ServiceEcas objects.

methods.name: getServiceGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of ServiceGroups objects.

methods.name: getServiceLocations
methods.description: Returns the list of ServiceLocation objects.

methods.name: getStartupServices
methods.description: Returns the list of StartupService objects.

methods.name: getThreadPool
methods.description: Returns the ThreadPool object associated with this service engine.
